title: State machine
description: process/states/<name>.yaml: the life of one thing (an issue, a worker, a notification...) as states and transitions (ADR-0017 decision 16), written by hand as YAML. Only name, title and source are required. `andon process render` makes docs/process/<name>.md from it. Only issue.yaml is read at run time: `andon issue` refuses a status change that it does not define (ADR-0017 decision 15). Only these keys.

name.description: The identifier: the lowercase English name, same as the file name without .yaml.

source.description: Where the definition comes from (ledger.md, an ADR and its decision numbers).

positions.description: Record fields that are not states: positions and data (the form dispatcher:LogPos).

id.description: An identifier: lowercase ASCII letters, digits and '-', starting with a letter.

text.description: Text a person reads. Not empty.

field.description: A record file and its top-level field: <record>:<Field> (dispatcher:Pending, signals:active).

end.description: A state id, or [*] for the start or the end.

id.description: The identifier of the state, unique in the file.

record.description: The record fields that hold this state. One or a list.

by.description: Who moves it: machine (dispatcher, gate, a command), ai, person or kanban (the ledger CLI).

command.description: The command that is run, if any.

once.description: true when it must not happen twice (the dispatcher.md section 7 table comes from these).
